question: What dark-colored reality is accessed by resorting to the yoginī's place?
premises: One resorts to the place of the yoginī.
A dark, black-colored reality is there.
This reality is the object of focus.
inference: By resorting to the yoginī's place, one accesses the dark, black-colored reality.
plain_english: Having resorted to the place of the yoginī, one encounters that which is dark and black-colored.
